content:
marisol: Quick postmortem follow-up — token-count overreporting impacted invoices for Mar 11–12 (~2.3% gross delta). Need clear owners + timelines for: 1) immediate invoice corrections, 2) ingest fix to prevent recurrence, 3) backfill/runbook to make future triage faster.

lina: I can own invoice corrections and credits. Need the exact ledger query + list of affected accounts.

kevin: Eng will take the ingest pipeline fix (hotfix + longer-term change). Planning hotfix today, full patch by Wed EOD. Will post PR.

samir: I'll add a monitoring alert for token-rate anomalies and a sanity check on batch ordering. Also will document the root cause in the infra playbook.

maggie: I'll own customer comms and the crediting policy doc. We should canary the corrections for high-value accounts first.

marisol: Owners confirmed: lina (invoice corrections & comms coordination), kevin (ingest hotfix + backfill orchestration), samir (alerts + playbook), maggie (customer messaging & credits). Timeline proposal: hotfix = today (dry-run), canary reprocess = Fri, full backfill = next Tue. Can everyone confirm?

lina: Confirmed. I'll start the corrections doc and share a spreadsheet with row-level counts by EOD.

kevin: Confirmed. Hotfix steps: 1) block delayed batch re-ingest, 2) force sequential ordering for recent window, 3) add unit test for run_id ordering. I'll open the PR shortly.

samir: Confirmed. I'll add a Grafana panel and a PagerDuty rule for token-rate delta > 0.5% over 1h.

maggie: Confirmed. Drafting a short note + credits table. Suggest we offer automatic credits for accounts that saw >1% delta and manual review for 0.5–1%.

lina: For the corrections run, SQL snippet I'm using (dry-run first):

```sql
-- dry-run: compute corrected billed tokens
SELECT account_id, SUM(corrected_tokens) AS corrected, SUM(billed_tokens) AS original
FROM ledger_staging
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-11' AND '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(billed_tokens) - SUM(corrected_tokens)) > 0;
```

lina: Actual update will be done via our ledger reprocess job to preserve audit trail. I'll attach the run_id to the invoice corrections.

kevin: Reprocessing command for infra runbook (dry-run flag available):

```bash
./bin/ledger_reprocess --since 2026-03-11 --until 2026-03-12 --dry-run --output csv
# when validated:
./bin/ledger_reprocess --since 2026-03-11 --until 2026-03-12 --run --tag "postmortem-2026-03-token-delta"
```

marisol: Good. Lina, once you have the spreadsheet can you post a sample of 10 accounts for us to sanity-check before canary?

lina: Yep. I'll post the sample in this thread and share the sheet link.

ops-bot: deploybot: hotfix deploy started for service=ingest-pipeline, run_id=deploy-20260323-09:14

kevin: Hotfix is live in staging. Running dry-run reprocess now and comparing aggregates.

maggie: I'll queue the customer notes and sync with CS. Planning to proactively reach out to top 50 impacted accounts after canary approval.

samir: Added playbook entry: "token-count-anomaly - triage checklist" with runbook steps and owners.

marisol: Action items summary (I'll paste to the PM tracker):
- lina: invoice correction spreadsheet + sample posted (ETA EOD today)
- kevin: hotfix PR + staging dry-run (ETA today), production hotfix if dry-run OK (ETA Wed EOD)
- samir: monitoring alert + playbook entry (ETA EOD)
- maggie: customer comms + credits policy draft (ETA Mon)

marisol: Anyone want to add or adjust deadlines? Otherwise I'll convert this into tasks and tag owners in the sprint.

kevin: fine w/ those dates. Will update PR with runbook steps.

lina: no changes.

samir: all good.

maggie: ok. I'll loop in CS for outreach cadence.

marisol: Thanks all — we'll recheck here after the staging dry-run results.
